audit_items.proof_trace: The flash_loan_lock is checked only within borrow_flash_loan (L804) to prevent nested flash loans for the same asset — it is not checked in handle_borrow or handle_withdraw. However, the property invariant holds via the independent is_obligation_safe guard enforced by handle_borrow (L424-434) and handle_withdraw (L332-342): an attacker who deposits flash-loaned tokens as collateral to inflate borrowing capacity cannot simultaneously withdraw that collateral to repay the flash loan if the withdrawal would leave the obligation undercollateralised, and repaying from the borrowed amount alone is mathematically impossible (LTV < 100% means borrowed ≤ collateral × LTV < collateral < flash-loan principal). The obligation safety invariant therefore cannot be bypassed via temporary liquidity injection.
